remainingWeaknesses: Flat terrain colour obscures city structure; steep cliff gaps and shoreline hard edge remain visibly unlikecs2_7. Building windows survive but roofs/walls do notread as sufficiently distinct shaded volumes.
Night colour remains dependent on underlying scene/fog and compositing despite unlit data material. No additive blending, exposure/fog hacks or fullscreen grey veil were introduced.
Live service category mapping is an owned bug; source remains frozen for independentr1 critique. Simulation and real service placement limitations are separately documented.

Landvalue normalsettled probe matched2draws; repeated cross-frame probing also saw+57 and-51 hostdrawdelta during scene/LODchanges. Those transient deltas cannot be attributed entirelytoinfoviews. See raw final-probe,settled-probe,shore-probe records; no cherry-pickedclaimofstablewholehost.
Off density A/B retains pink reflected terrain onwater while ownmeshvisibility iszero: possible planarreflection cache/layer seam. No sourceclaimthatdeactivationinstantlyclearscachedreflection.

Pixel classification is fullresolution, but value ranking uses64x36ground lattice and maymisclassify building-facevalues. Fogcomparison unmeasurable. LandvaluecropAABBs stillmixsurfaces; densitynearplane defect explicit.

Main28andmask14captures precede only a ready-status guard indata/showcase (unchangedfullmodebehavior); final reducedcaptures refresh affectedpaths. source-hashes.json preservespre-guard hashes; source-hashes-final.json recordsfreeze.
